roofOptions.externalForm: Both options keep the accepted external roof shape, dormers, levels and stair position. The choice concerns retaining versus replacing the existing roof structure.

options.label: A · Retain and adapt the existing roof
options.description: Keep surviving original-house roof structure where survey and load checks allow. Form the agreed dormers, roof junctions and new wings; allow for local strengthening and temporary support.
options.risks: Existing timber condition, connections, bearings and capacity are unverified. Local strengthening and the demolition already needed for the agreed alterations remain unpriced.

options.label: B · Remove and rebuild the existing roof
options.description: Strip the existing roof completely and construct the agreed roof shape with a new coordinated frame. New framing replaces every surviving original-roof surface shown in Option A; altered/new roof areas are common to both options.
options.risks: Requires a full replacement roof design, demolition/propping/weather protection, wall-head checks, temporary stability and connection design. Replacement member sizes currently reserve space only.

loftFloor.scope: Full replacement of original loft joists and boarding; new joists across the complete loft footprint, with real stair/void openings preserved.
loftFloor.basis: Owner instruction 26 October 2026: remove the existing roof and loft joists entirely. Existing lower-storey structure remains unless altered. New-member dimensions, supports and temporary works require design.

gardenRoom.basis: Garden room/rear extension follows the accepted 500 mm inset and 2 m chamfer. All members are coordination reservations; roof terrace loads, stability, connections, foundation reactions, waterproofing and thermal design remain unverified. Existing house openings remain; glazing is not treated as a structural support.
